kubejs.ponder.seared_smelter_ponder.head: Seared Smelter
kubejs.ponder.seared_smelter_ponder.text: The Seared Smelter is an early game smeltery. It can be used to melt metals
You must provide a Heat source (with a Seared Heater)
kubejs.ponder.smeltery_ponder.text_1: The Smeltery Controller must be placed on a side
kubejs.ponder.smeltery_ponder.text_2: A heat source must be provided (with a Seared Fluid Tank)
kubejs.ponder.smeltery_ponder.text_3: A Seared Drain can be used to pull the liquified metal out
kubejs.ponder.smeltery_ponder.text_4: The liquified metal can be molded in an casting table using a cast
